-- Money transfer between two immutable accounts. Every function returns new state.
type Account = { balance: Int }

type TransferError = InsufficientFunds | InvalidAmount

type Transfer = { from: Account, to: Account }

fn debit(account: Account, amount: Int) -> Result<Account, TransferError>
  intent "کم کردن مبلغ از حساب؛ اگر موجودی کافی نباشد خطا برمی‌گرداند"
  requires amount > 0
  example debit({balance: 100}, 30) == ok({balance: 70})
  example debit({balance: 10}, 30) == err(InsufficientFunds)
do
  if account.balance < amount then
    return err(InsufficientFunds)
  end if
  return ok({balance: account.balance - amount})
end fn

fn credit(account: Account, amount: Int) -> Account
  intent "اضافه کردن مبلغ به حساب"
  requires amount > 0
  ensures out.balance == account.balance + amount
  example credit({balance: 5}, 3) == {balance: 8}
do
  return {balance: account.balance + amount}
end fn

fn transfer(from: Account, to: Account, amount: Int) -> Result<Transfer, TransferError>
  intent "انتقال پول بین دو حساب بدون تغییر حساب‌های ورودی"
  requires amount > 0
  ensures result.is_ok(out) implies result.unwrap(out).from.balance == from.balance - amount
  ensures result.is_ok(out) implies result.unwrap(out).to.balance == to.balance + amount
  example transfer({balance: 100}, {balance: 0}, 30) == ok({from: {balance: 70}, to: {balance: 30}})
  example transfer({balance: 10}, {balance: 0}, 30) == err(InsufficientFunds)
do
  let debited = debit(from, amount)?
  let credited = credit(to, amount)
  return ok({from: debited, to: credited})
end fn
